exercises.question: Which sentence gives a cause? [¿Cuál expresa una causa?]
options: Tenemos derechos porque somos ciudadanos. [We have rights because we are citizens.]
Tenemos derechos; por eso somos ciudadanos. [We have rights; therefore we are citizens.]
Somos ciudadanos; sin embargo, tenemos derechos. [We are citizens; however, we have rights.]

exercises.sentence: La regla es necesaria; ___ debemos cumplirla. (por eso) [The rule is necessary; therefore we must follow it.]

exercises.english: We have rights because we are citizens.

sentences: La regla es necesaria. [The rule is necessary.]
La regla es necesaria; por eso debemos cumplirla. [The rule is necessary; therefore we must follow it.]

exercises.question: Which word means «consequence»? [¿Qué palabra significa «consecuencia»?]
options: consecuencia [consequence]
responsabilidad [responsibility]
derecho [right]

exercises.sentence: La decisión tuvo una ___ importante. (consecuencia) [The decision had an important consequence.]

exercises.english: Because of the situation, they changed the rule.

options: We have rights because we are citizens.

options: Because of the situation, they changed the rule.
